name: 34113 · Naples, FL
findings: ZIP 34113 (Naples) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34113 (Naples) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 34113 (Naples) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
